integrity_notes: Exact analytic derivation is supplied; a self-contained Python 3 checker uses supplementary exact-rational and high-precision finite tests. No experimental or external audit is characterized as proof of the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to the stated two-pixel periodic positive convolution with identity image/auxiliary regularizers, positive quadratic/auxiliary scales, uniform base prior and a nonconstant observed Fourier component. No classification is claimed beyond the stated small-auxiliary-scale regime or for larger blur families. Finite calculations supplement the all-parameter proof. Independent review is absent.
title: A sharp no-blur-to-complete-blur transition for log-determinant variable projection
